items.title: New train service connects Finland and Sweden for first time in decades
items.dek: The service will enable rail travel from Portugal to Lapland - what is believed to be the longest train journey in Europe.

items.title: Russian court bars only anti-war party from standing in parliamentary elections
items.dek: Russia's only liberal, anti-war party will not be able to take part in next month's parliamentary elections, a Moscow court rules.
